title: Human Body Single-Cell Atlas of 3D Genome Organization and DNA Methylation
authors: Zhou J; Wu Y; Liu H; Tian W; Castanon RG; Bartlett A; Zhang Z; Yao G; Shi D; Clock B; Marcotte S; Nery JR; Liem M; Claffey N; Boggeman L; Barragan C; e Drigo RA; Weimer AK; Shi M; Cooper-Knock J; Zhang S; Snyder MP; Preissl S; Ren B; O’Connor C; Chen S; Luo C; Dixon JR; Ecker JR
one_liner_zh: 该研究绘制人类单细胞3D基因组与DNA甲基化图谱，虽涉及染色质结构，但未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Higher-order chromatin structure and DNA methylation are critical for gene regulation, but how these vary across the human body remains unclear. We performed multi-omic profiling of 3D genome structure and DNA methylation for 86,689 single nuclei across 16 human tissues, identifying 35 major and 206 cell subtypes. We revealed extensive changes in CG and non-CG methylation across almost all cell types and characterized 3D chromatin structure at an unprecedented cellular resolution. Intriguingly, extensive discrepancies exist between cell types delineated by DNA methylation and genome structure, indicating that the role of distinct epigenomic features in maintaining cell identity may vary by lineage. This study expands our understanding of the diversity of DNA methylation and chromatin structure and offers an extensive reference for exploring gene regulation in human health and disease.
abstract_zh: 高阶染色质结构与DNA甲基化对于基因调控至关重要，但这些特征在人体各组织间如何变化仍不清楚。我们对来自16个人体组织的86,689个单核进行了三维基因组结构与DNA甲基化的多组学分析，识别出35种主要细胞亚型和206种细胞亚型。我们揭示了几乎所有细胞类型中CG和非CG甲基化的广泛变化，并以前所未有的细胞分辨率刻画了3D染色质结构。有趣的是，由DNA甲基化和基因组结构界定的细胞类型之间存在显著差异，表明不同表观基因组特征在维持细胞身份中的作用可能因谱系而异。本研究扩展了我们对DNA甲基化与染色质结构多样性的理解，并为探索人类健康与疾病中的基因调控提供了广泛参考。
